title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Five thousand Pesos to Enable the Philippine Islands to Be Represented At the Far Eastern Athletic Association Meet At Shanghai, China.

text.en:
The sum of five thousand pesos, is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury
not otherwise appropriated, for the payment of traveling expenses, subsistence and incidental expenses of the
representatives of the Philippine Islands at the meet of the Far Eastern Athletic Association to be held at
Shanghai, China, in October, nineteen hundred and fourteen. Such representatives shall be selected by the
Philippine Amateur Athletic Federation subject to approval of the Secretary of Public Instruction.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 28, 1914.
